decision: Approve frozen helper bytes for actual canonical-run acceptance audit. No remaining source blocker. This review does not assert canonical Run130 has passed.

resolved_findings.initial_gap: Join compared stored artifact descriptors without rehashing actual retained F9/XML/process artifact bytes after component audits.
resolved_findings.resolution: Join now rehashes every generic artifact_inventory.files member with path containment and exact bytes/SHA checks before acceptance.

resolved_findings.initial_gap: Selected API execution job rows were checked for name/status/success but not their actual run_id/head_sha.
resolved_findings.resolution: Each actual execution job now must equal claimed run.id and run.head_sha as well as name/completed/success.

resolved_findings.initial_gap: Discovery/public auditor identity was bound but its invoked source parser identity was not rechecked.
resolved_findings.resolution: Join now requires both accepted_parser_identity receipts equal exact current canonical parser helper bytes.

join_findings.run_and_source: Requires successful completed pull_request on unchanged canonical windows-tests.yml, full source/checkout/baseline SHAs, source head match and generic source provenance equal [master,source] merge-parent record. Component run_id/run_attempt/source/checkout and workflow head must match. Audited source files are reread from source/checkout commit blobs.
join_findings.complete_job_identity: Requires exactly23 uniquely named successful jobs, exact set of twelve Windows registered suites plus public contracts plus ten explicitly named other jobs, each API execution identity tied to same run/head and hashed log. Every real checkout log must name exact checkout; only explicit seven-day aggregate has no checkout.
join_findings.test_identity: Complete registered suite set and source-selected/observed counts must agree. Exact script/test pair sets and selected XML evidence must match;13 XML files and generic counts agree. Both new native retirement case identities are mandatory.
join_findings.component_provenance: Component report file hashes, component auditor identities, invoked accepted parser and F5 helper identities, all declared metadata, source files, job/log records and artifact archive identities bound. Fresh artifact-member hashes close the post-audit mutation gap.
join_findings.public_boundaries: Both generated public inventories required; exact adopted artifact/source/checkout equality and unchanged contract declarations required. Public source owner bytes bound.
join_findings.scope: Original eight catalogue-v1 processes and F5 writer/reader are required via embedded audited component; physical catalogue-v2 remains independently required. Other canonical jobs are explicitly scoped to observed command/step success, without claiming independent payload semantics or all Beads completion.

v3_findings.inherited_checks: Seven F9 semantic stages, real separate-frame input receipts, strict leak/error rejection, raw primary neutrality, exact16×14 external recovery operations,64 reconstructed transaction markers and raw recovery endpoints retain v2 requirements.
v3_findings.source_binding_behavior: Each added source is hashed from source commit and required byte-identical in tested checkout. No runtime success is inferred solely from source hashes.
v3_findings.path_representation_correction: F9 process user_dir may equal retained F5 user_dir exactly or exactly that string plus one trailing slash. No path component normalization, parent traversal, prefix matching or alternate directory admitted.
v3_findings.focus4_raw_confirmation: Independently read actual Focus4 raw top result: F5 and F9 nested result user_dir end in DWM; process report ends in DWM/. All three name the same exact directory.
v3_findings.predecessor_preservation: v3 records immutable v1 and v2 auditor identities and writes distinct v3 output; historical failures remain separate.

validation.python_ast_parse: All eight reviewed Python files parsed with ast.parse, without generating bytecode or invoking engines.

limits: Source review approves helper logic and exact bytes only; final success requires the actual canonical broad run and same-run component audits.
Join reuses completed component semantics and rehashes their input artifacts; it does not reexecute Godot/PowerShell or the entire historical independent auditor collection.
Retained ZIP API/provenance and extracted artifact bytes are bound via generic audit and fresh member hashes; no new arbitrary-filesystem or OS-crash guarantee is claimed.
